description:
Create a new Activity log in farmOS Field Kit to document a livestock move.

Details to enter:
- Date: January 6, 2025
- Log Type: Activity (default)
- Quantity: 24
- Unit: head
- Notes: "Rotational grazing move. Moved 24 Angus cow-calf pairs from North Pasture A (Section 12) to South Pasture B (Section 7). North Pasture A residual forage height: 3 inches. South Pasture B forage height at entry: 8 inches. Estimated 14 grazing days in South Pasture B. Next rotation planned January 20, 2025. Water tank checked and functioning."

Steps:
1. Create a new log.
2. Set the date, notes, and quantity as specified above.
3. Save the log.
4. Verify the new log appears in the list.
